description: Emits synthetic HL7 v2, C-CDA, FHIR or X12 messages on every poll interval and pushes them onto the queue. Pick the message type from a dropdown. Everything it produces is invented test data, so it carries no PHI. Use it to build and load-test an interface before a live feed exists.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, to emit a batch of messages. 10000 is ten seconds. Lower it to raise throughput for a load test.

config.label: Message Type
config.description: Which message to generate. Each option is a complete, realistic message of that type.

config.label: Messages Per Interval
config.description: How many messages to emit on each interval. 1 for a demo feed; raise it to generate load. Capped at 1000 per interval.

config.label: Topic
config.description: Optional queue topic to publish to. Leave empty to use the node's configured destination, which is what a normal workflow wants.

config.label: Randomize Content
config.description: On, each message picks a patient at random. Off, patients are used in a fixed rotation, which makes a run repeatable.

config.label: Random Seed
config.description: 0 varies the output on every start. Any other value pins the sequence, so the same run produces the same messages - use it for a regression test.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, messages are generated and counted but never queued. Use it to confirm the node is configured before it starts producing traffic.
